audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradicted both the packet chart and the page's own whys[] text: Level 1 read Akshan, Level 2 Skill, Level 3 Tryndamere, Level 6 Akshan.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Skill/Akshan/Skill/Tryndamere/Skill/Tryndamere/Tryndamere, and whys[0] says Level 1 is even, whys[1] says Level 2 is Akshan's, whys[2] says Level 3 is skill-dependent, whys[4] says Level 6 is skill-based.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 realigned in both layers as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing is the ability the whole page is keyed to and its 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s cooldown was never stated, nor its terrain requirement.
audit.why: Heroic Swing fires a hook into terrain — in the open lane he simply cannot use it, which decides where you choose to engage.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the 18s rank-1 cooldown and the terrain requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: Comeuppance was called an execute in two places. Riot's text says it deals damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion or structure hit — no threshold.
audit.why: 'Execute' tells the player his health bar is a cliff; missing-health scaling instead means the shot is weakest at full health and can be body-blocked by a minion, which is the actual counterplay.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and whys[4] restate it as missing-health damage that hits the first thing in the line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Going Rogue's camouflage was never mentioned and Tryndamere has no reveal in his kit.
audit.why: Nothing in Tryndamere's kit answers camouflage, so a Control Ward and sweeper are a requirement, not a preference.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names Going Rogue and the Control Ward.

edits.before: Skill-based at 6: his R Comeuppance is a long-charge execute, but you can pop Undying Rage to eat it, or E out of the channel. Don't sit still in his ult range when your own R is down.
edits.after: Skill-based at 6: Comeuppance stores bullets and scales off your missing health, so it punishes you low. Pop Undying Rage through it, or put a minion between you — it hits the first thing in the line.

edits.before: Level 6 is skill-based since his R Comeuppance can execute you while your R is down.
edits.after: Level 6 is skill-based since Comeuppance hits harder the lower you are and your R is down.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 and needs terrain to grapple — engage once it is spent.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — 18s at rank 1, and the hook needs terrain to swing from. - Going Rogue camouflages him: carry a Control Ward and sweep the bush. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d are boilerplate that does not match their own titles ('Trade at zero fury' / 'Eat his Heroic Swing for free'); left alone rather than replaced with text that would mismatch differently. Point 4 note for a later pass: Dirty Fighting shields him every third hit on a champion, so his first exchange is effectively longer than the health bars suggest.
